title.ja: L字角の特異解：調和場と別の滑らかな製造解
title.en: L-corner singularity: harmonic field and separate smooth MMS

references.formula: u=r^(2/3)*sin(2*theta/3); -Delta(u)=0; theta in[0,3*pi/2]; separate square MMS u=sin(pi*x)*sin(pi*y).

assumptions.ja: 第4象限を除いた[-1,1]²、theta∈[0,3pi/2]、u=r^(2/3)sin(2theta/3)、解析Dirichlet。N8/16/32、graded map x→x max(|x|,|y|)。正方形sin(pi x)sin(pi y)を同Nのregular/warpedで別検査。角の解析解と勾配を要素求積し、一様格子と事前graded格子を同じ自由度で比べます。別の単位正方形でsin(πx)sin(πy)をregular/warped格子へ置き、特異性と歪みを分けます。
assumptions.en: L-shaped[-1,1]² minus quadrantIV, theta0..3pi/2, analytic Dirichlet harmonic corner field. N8/16/32, fixed map x→x max(|x|,|y|). Separate unit-square sine MMS uses regular/warped grids. Integrate the analytic corner field and gradient over elements, comparing uniform and a-priori graded meshes at matched DOFs. A separate unit-square sine MMS on regular/warped meshes separates singularity from distortion.

note.ja: 特異解に正方形のL2二次を要求しません。固定の事前graded写像でありAMRソフトではありません。条件数は推定で、任意歪みへの保証はしません。
note.en: No smooth-square L2 order is imposed on the singular field. Fixed a-priori grading is not an AMR engine. Conditioning is estimated; arbitrary distortion is not certified.

reference_note.ja: L2/H1積分誤差・求積差、一様/gradedの同DOF改善、別のsquare/warped系列、最小角・aspect・1ノルム条件数推定・真の線形残差を保存。
reference_note.en: Retain integrated L2/H1 errors, quadrature gaps, matched-DOF grading improvement, separate square/warp errors, minimum angle/aspect, estimated1-norm conditioning and true residuals.

method_note.ja: 面積と物理勾配からP1剛性を組み、境界を消去して疎直接法で解きます。隅要素は原点をDuffy写像の頂点に移し、Gauss48/96を比較。
method_note.en: Assemble physical P1 gradients/areas, eliminate boundary data and solve sparse systems. Corner triangles use origin-based Duffy quadrature48/96.
